steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (There's about as many people as Siesta, but the atmosphere's completely different.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Everywhere I look, bars, casinos, restaurants...)

steps.name: Flighty Tourist
steps.text: Hey, pretty lady, wanna come join us on the beach?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Piss. Off.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Lin Yühsia vanished into thin air this morning.)

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I was just about to give that stinky sewer rat another call.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I may not come here often, but I'm pretty sure those special forces are up to no good.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have you met Lin? From the slums?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I have. He's a nice old man. Nicer than my grandpa anyway.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They call him the 'Rat King.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Aren't the men behind the curtain all like such? But he's really a good person.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I never thought Yühsia would turn out like this. She was such a shy and timid girl, the kind who would always hide behind you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't think she's changed. She just... took on responsibility. Maybe the kind she couldn't handle.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Whatever, she can't hide for long.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *sigh*. I'm already here. May as well find something to do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Like what... buy some Dossoles goodies?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (It'd be kind of complicated to ship souvenirs to Hoshiguma and Swire... I'll just wait for them to visit Rhodes Island.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Right, I need to get a thank-you gift for Lady Fumizuki too.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (As for the Rhodes Islanders... Shirayuki, Bagpipe, Amiya, and... her?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Whatever. It's a lot of people to buy for, and I don't know if I can carry that much back. We'll see how things go.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (But I get the feeling this won't need too long...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Should I go for a walk...? I guess I'll be walking, no matter what I do.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Maybe have Ernesto give me a quick tour of the city?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Nah... I don't know him well enough.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Right, there was what Mayor Candela said...)

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: These past few days, circulation of weapons in the city has grown unusually prevalent. If you feel you aren't having as much fun as you'd like at any point during your stay here, perhaps you should try your hand at the investigation. For fun.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (For a mayor, she clearly doesn't care one bit about her own city. How did Wei Yenwu get a friend like that?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (And besides, this city is one big luxury resort. It practically defines 'decadent'...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (This place is more Swire's speed. I'd rather be back in Siesta.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Ugh, what—ever. I'm here already, and investigating's better than nothing. Let's give it a fair shake.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (I could ask Ernesto about Mayor Candela's case, but if they had any definite leads, something would've happened long ago.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Just asking won't get me anywhere. Roaming it is. Start by getting the lay of the land.)

steps.name: Chagrined Male Tourist
steps.text: How was the fight last night?

steps.name: Cheerful Male Tourist
steps.text: Won a few thousand. You?

steps.name: Chagrined Male Tourist
steps.text: Ugh. I lost bad.

steps.name: Cheerful Male Tourist
steps.text: Ha ha, no biggie. Just win it back today, right?

steps.name: Chagrined Male Tourist
steps.text: Conchetumare, I was gonna, even if you didn't say. It's just better here. No way I wanna go back.

steps.name: Cheerful Male Tourist
steps.text: I hear you. Once we get out of this place, it's back to death and gore again.

steps.name: Cheerful Male Tourist
steps.text: Damn, you know? If we just had the money to buy an apartment here.

steps.name: Chagrined Male Tourist
steps.text: Win enough bets and we will, yeah?

steps.name: Cheerful Male Tourist
steps.text: Ha ha ha, you got me there!

steps.name: Upbeat Bartender
steps.text: Excuse me, lovely young lady, could I interest you in a job at our bar?

steps.name: Upbeat Bartender
steps.text: A woman as gorgeous as you could make crazy money in one night.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Piss. Off.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Casinos, bars, restaurants, karaoke boxes. Is that all they ever built in this city?
...The preliminary phase is near its end.
Ch'en turns to look, and realizes the voice is coming from a display TV in a shop window.

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: Locals and visitors from afar, are you having the vacation time of your lives?

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: I lost three hundred thousand at the casino last night, but you bet I'm gonna win it back today.

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: So, after ten days of fierce competition, the Dossoles Warrior Champion holds its final prelim contest today!

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: And this afternoon at 3 P.M.—that's in three hours, folks—we'll be treated to the final Smash Splash Prelim!

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: It's a bout you championship-lovers absolutely cannot miss! Be there, and bathe in the excitement!

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: But of course, there's no need to panic if you don't wanna fight the scorching heat or the crowds! Keep your eyes on our official channel, and we'll have live coverage for you!

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: And before we forget, we've got some news for you music-heads that'll shake the world.

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: That's right, you've probably already heard—in a huge move, Mayor Candela has invited the Monster Siren Records legend, D.D.D.

steps.name: TV Presenter
steps.text: And that's not all. The masked musician's unleashing more than her bold electro. She's going to be hosting the championship!

steps.name: Impatient Male Tourist
steps.text: Nina, c'mon, didn't you hear that? Three hours until the match starts.

steps.name: Sluggish Female Tourist
steps.text: What's so fun about a fight? It's barbarous.

steps.name: Impatient Male Tourist
steps.text: Anyone who passes the scrimmage prelim ends up a dark horse in the championship. It's something you've gotta keep tabs on.

steps.name: Sluggish Female Tourist
steps.text: Then you go watch. Tell me what happens.

steps.name: Impatient Male Tourist
steps.text: Come on, lady... pft, fine. I'll go on my own, then, suit yourself.

steps.name: Male Music-Loving Tourist
steps.text: Hey, you think it's true? I heard D.D.D. was coming a few days ago, but I had no idea if it's for real.

steps.name: Female Music-Loving Tourist
steps.text: If I'm remembering right, she was in Siesta just last month. Wild that she's here in Dossoles now.

steps.name: Female Music-Loving Tourist
steps.text: And how do you even get her to host your thing? What did Mayor Candela say to win her over?!

steps.name: Male Music-Loving Tourist
steps.text: Her?

steps.name: Female Music-Loving Tourist
steps.text: You didn't know? We got strong odds nowadays that D.D.D.'s a female artist.

steps.name: Male Music-Loving Tourist
steps.text: Huh... doesn't mean much to me if she's a man or a woman. What really matters is our ears are in for a treat!
Ch'en realizes that practically everyone is talking about the competition.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Seems it's gripped the whole city.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (If you want to get something done here, what better way than to go undercover as a competitor? Think of all the opportunities you could make out of the chaos.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (And in that case...)

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Hey, is that Miss Ch'en? Haha, sorry, I'm a little tied up on this end right now.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Hiyah!

steps.name: Sound from Receiver
steps.text: Gaagh!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you fighting with someone? What's going on?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It's a long story. The short version is Miss Lin is having trouble making friends.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where are you? I'll come over.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Sure, I'm at...
Three hours ago

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why did you help him?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Juvenile.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Need me to assist, Miss Lin?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You said you were very familiar with this city.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Any options for a small, independent, quiet casino?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Independent, quiet... You want the kind of place where you can make trouble without it blowing up?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No worries, then. With Ms. Candela around, no one will dare get in your way.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: No. I want the kind that won't be a pain to tidy up.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: ...I get you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This is the place?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Right. A casino bar, more precisely.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The proprietor, Arraz, started it from nothing. Gave it everything he had to make it on this street, and got the place to where it is today.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The powers on the streets around all want it for themselves, but nobody's got the teeth to break through his bones.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Excellent.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You wait here.

steps.name: Casino Hotshot
steps.text: May I ask if you're here to drink, or to play a hand?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: To play a hand.

steps.name: Casino Hotshot
steps.text: T-Tough lady we got here...

steps.name: Casino Hotshot
steps.text: Q-Quick, call the boss!

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Miss, I don't care who you are, but you're too big for your britches, all alone and rowdy in a place like this.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Cut the drivel. Deal.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Quads. Heheheh...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Straight flush.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: How?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You're awful at palming cards.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Miss, I'll admit you might have some real skill...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Can we speed this up? Draw, already. I'm in a hurry.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Grr. It's go time, boys!

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Well, I did familiarize myself with her...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But this is the way the Rat King's daughter does things.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where's Lin Yühsia?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You're here, Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That bunch ran after they couldn't handle Miss Lin. She went to chase them down.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Which way?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That way, towards the beach.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Got it. I'll go check it out.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They sprint fast, I'll give them that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lin Yühsia, what the hell are you doing?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Ch'en Hui-chieh? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm the one asking you.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Gah, where'd this nutcase pop up from? We can't beat her, we can't shake her off.

steps.name: Casino Hotshot
steps.text: Boss, what do we do?

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: What else? Keep running.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Is that... where they're hosting the scrimmage prelim?

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Heh, perfect. We're going in!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Found them.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: No time to babysit you right now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hold it!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There you are.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: You even found us here?

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Hmph. Good thing we've got plenty of help on hand.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Guys, let's go!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where are we...? Isn't this the Smash Splash place they mentioned on TV?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Grr. I guess we'll have to clear the field first.
